attributes.action: You can only hold your phone up at a concert one time for maximum 30 seconds
attributes.additional_details: I just can't see very well, you know?
attributes.background:
I would like people to be strongly encouraged to only hold their phone up one time during the duration of a concert, for a maximum of 30 seconds.

Maybe bands should be legally required to share the set list in advance, so people can plan when they want to hold their phones up.

rejection.details: This is not a matter for the Government but a policy that can be applied by concert venues or required by bands/artists.
